corpus_law: SYNTHETIC sessions, varied facts+emotion. The outcome class of each observation is DERIVED FROM ITS EXTRACTED FACTS BY THE WRITTEN POLICY (receipt-mentioned + purchase-window → full refund / store credit / manager review) — never from a model, never hand-assigned contrary to the facts. Observations whose policy-input facts are not grounded carry expected:null and are the fact-starved cohort (they must be REFUSED, never frozen). This is the grown corpus the wave-67 freeze-report said the unchanged instrument needed (n≥14); live-session corroboration remains the promotion bar for the live sheet.
policy: full refund within 7 days with a receipt, store credit without, manager review after 7 days
